metadata.prompt:
(Intro parlé / lent, dramatique)

« Côté Frais c’est l’taf, l’camion, la route…
Mais c’est aussi la cage, la boule, la fierté.
Même guerre, même codes… »

⸻

(Couplet 1 – 16 mesures)
Jason pilote son VL comme il gère ses coqs,
Stratégie sur l’parking ou dans la box.
Chargement lourd, manœuvre précise,
Comme l’ergot aiguisé qui vise.

Il connaît la route comme son arène,
Faut prévoir l’virage, calculer la veine.
Pas d’place pour l’hésite, faut doser la force,
Comme dans la cage où la mort te tord.

Chez Côté Frais on se lève à l’aube,
Froid dans le frigo, cœur sous la toge.
Même tension qu’avant l’combat,
Silence pesant quand la cage s’ouvrira.

Faut gérer l’équipe comme on dresse la bête,
Donner les consignes, contrôler la fête.
Parce que sur l’bitume ou sur l’sable du ring,
C’est le même combat qu’on vit, cousin.

⸻

(Pont / demi-refrain – 8 mesures)
Côté Frais c’est l’arène moderne,
Livraison serrée, regard qui cerne.
Combat de coq c’est l’autre facette,
Même famille, même stress qu’on s’met.
Jason c’est l’pilote et le dresseur,
Route ou cage, il impose la peur.
Même sang, même honneur qu’on porte,
Travail ou passion, on joue la mort.

⸻

(Couplet 2 – 16 mesures – focus cousins et équipe)
Micky s’perd dans ses oiseaux qui chantent,
Chardonnerets calmes, poésie planante.
Jason sourit mais il pense au combat,
Son coq qui attend le moment fatal.

Ricky snap même quand on s’entraîne,
Sur le quai ou l’arène, la même scène.
Steven veut l’cross mais revient pour voir,
Le clash des coqs, l’odeur d’la gloire.

Milian fait rager dans l’camion,
Mais il hurle quand la cage s’ouvre, passion.
Jordy râle mais parie sur l’bon,
Investit sur l’coq, sur le champion.

Et le soir après la pétanque apaise,
On se charcle à la boule, on s’vide la tête.
Mais c’est toujours la même soif de vaincre,
La même fierté qu’on veut pas feindre.

⸻

(Refrain – 8 mesures – plus chantable, jonction claire)
Côté Frais ou combats de coq,
Même combat, même besoin d’choquer.
Sur l’parking ou sur la terre,
Faut des nerfs, faut l’art, faut la guerre.
Camion ou cage c’est la même école,
Stratégie fine, pas d’rôle pour les môles.
Jason les guide sur la route ou la scène,
Parce qu’on vit pour l’arène.

⸻

(Outro – 8 mesures – parlé/rap lent, plus sombre et conclusif)

« On charge les cagettes comme on arme l’ergot,
On livre la fraîcheur mais on saigne pour l’drapeau.
Famille soudée dans l’travail ou le ring,
Même si ça gueule, on vise le king.
Côté Frais c’est la base, c’est la cage,
On dresse nos coqs comme on forme les gars.
Jason pilote, Jason dompte,
Entre la route et l’arène, c’est le même compte. »

✅ Caractéristiques :

✔ ~40+ mesures, donc assez long pour un vrai son

✔ Jonction explicite entre taf VL et passion combats de coq
✔ Rimes riches, assonances, punchlines
✔ Structure prête à caler sur instru (trap, boom-bap, drill)

metadata.prompt:
The word of Yahowah came to me,His voice like thunder rolled,
“Go cry within Yerushalayim,recall the love of old.
I planted you a choice young vine,the first fruits of My care,
All nations that would touch your seed were guilty then to bear.”
“Yet what unrighteousness was found that made you turn away?
I led you through the desert lands,through night as well as day.
I brought you to a fruitful field,its harvest full & wide,
But you defiled My pleasant land, cast covenant aside.”
“The priests no longer ask of Me,the shepherds turn astray,
The scribes who claim to hold My word twist truth from light to clay.
The prophets speak for Baʿals name,pursue what cannot save,
They traded Yahowahs living spring for dust within a grave.”
“O hear, you skies,be desolate,let heavens reel with dread,
For Yisra’el has doubled sin, by which their lives are led.
They’ve left the fountain pure & clear, My waters flowing free,
& hewn for them cracked cistern walls that hold no drop for thee.”
“Is Yisra’el a servant born, a slave within the land?
Why has he come to spoil & chains beneath a stranger’s hand?
The lions roar, their voices ring, his cities burned with flame,
Noph & Tahpanhes consume, they mock his fallen name.”
“Have you not done this to yourself by leaving Yah your guide?
When I had led you in the way, your feet would not abide.
You drank from Nile, from Euphrates, you sought a foreign stream,
But all that flowed was bitter gall, illusion, empty dream.”
“How can you say, ‘I am not stained, no Baʿal have I known’?
Look to the valley, see your path, your deeds already shown.
Like restless camel in her heat, you run from side to side,
Your thirst enslaved, you chase the wind, no fountain will provide.”
“A thief is shamed when he is caught, so Yisra’el bears the same,
Their kings, their priests, their carved out poles all stumble into shame.
They say to wood, ‘You are my father,’ to stone, ‘You gave my birth,’
Yet turn their back on Yahowahs face,the Maker of the earth.”
“When trouble comes they cry to Me, ‘Arise, come rescue now!’
But where are all your fashioned gods, the ones you chose to bow?
Let them arise if they can save, your numbers match their size,
But empty is their breath of wood, their silence fills the skies.”
“O Yisra’el, you wearied Me with endless shifting ways,
Like she-camel who turns her track,like vine that twists and sways.
I disciplined, but you refused,your face grew harder still,
You killed the prophets sent to you,despised My voice, My will.”
“A generation, see My word,have I been desert land?
A darkness in your path of life,a weight you cannot stand?
Yet you have said, ‘We will be free, we will not walk with Thee,’
Your path is traced with stains of blood beneath the terebinth tree.”
“You sit upon the roadside there like thief who waits at night,
You’ve filled the land with treachery, with snares on every height.
And yet you say, ‘I am not touched, no wrath will come on me,’
Behold, I enter judgment now, your guilt the nations see.”
“The swift will stumble in his run, the strong will fall in strife,
Your hands have raised the falsewood pole, your lips betrayed your life.
As donkey gasps in desert heat, you chase what cannot feed,
No turning from your path of lust, no ending of your greed.”
“Yisra’el, you were bride to Me, I clothed you in My care,
But now you spread your bed with strangers, shameless everywhere.
Like dromedary in twisting course, you never still your feet,
& when the thirst consumes your throat, you spurn the spring replete.”
“The stain of harlot clings to you, though you should wash with lye,
Your guilt before My face remains, no cleansing can you buy.
You say, ‘I have not gone astray, no Baʿal have I kissed,’
But in the valley’s darkened plain your footprints still persist.”
“How lightly do you cheapen Me, & change your way each day,
Like reed that bends to every gust, you shift & turn away.
I’ll plead My case, I’ll charge you now, your daughters bear disgrace,
Your lovers will abandon you, & shame will take their place.”
“O Yahuwdah, house of Dowd, why choose the foreign road?
Why drink the Nile or Euphrates, reject your native load?
You’ll be disgraced by Mitsrayms hand, Asshur will strike you too,
You’ll turn and find that all your paths are filled with shame anew.”
“Your evil teaches, backsliding burns, your ways bring your reproof,
See that it’s bitter leaving Me, My life your only truth.
I broke your yoke, I tore your chains, but still you said, ‘I will
Not serve Yahowah’s covenant, I’ll chase my own path still.’”
“O generations, hear this word, has ever nation changed
Its elohim for worthless dust, exchanged for what is strange?
But Yisrael has left her Rock,her glory cast aside,
For idols that are emptiness, for rivers that run dry.”
Thus says Yahowah, Ruler sure, “Return, My people, hear,
I am the fountain living full, My waters flowing near.
Do not hew cisterns cracked & void that cannot hold the rain,
But drink from Me,the spring of life, and you’ll be whole again

metadata.prompt:
Introducción :(Instrumental)

(Verso 1:Voz cruda, rasgada, entra con energía contenida)
Tienen hambre de culpas nuevas,
las reparten como pan.
Cuchillos envueltos en frases hechas,
juicios sin mirar atrás.

Nadie pregunta qué hubo antes,
qué batalla se perdió.
Solo importa el titular fácil,
“culpable” suena mejor.

(Pre-estribillo:Cambia un poco la armonía, sube tensión emocional)
Y si todos llevamos grietas,
¿por qué solo ves las mías?
¿Quién te dio la piedra eterna
para lanzar sin sangrar?

(Estribillo:Explosión sonora: guitarras al frente, batería con redobles, voz potente)
¡Rómpete los cristales sucios!
¡Mírate sin el disfraz!
No hay villanos sin historia,
ni pecados sin verdad.

¡Basta ya de ser verdugos
con el pulso moral!
La empatía es más valiente
que tu juicio tribal.

(Solo de guitarra)

(Verso2: Más rabia, voz más decidida)
Nos vendieron redenciones
que se compran al pagar,
pero nadie te enseña el arte
de escuchar sin condenar.

Hay errores que enseñaron
más que todo tu perdón.
Y si el dolor no te hizo humano,
¿qué aprendiste del dolor?

(Preestribillo2: Sutil variación melódica del anterior pre-estribillo)
Y si todos fuimos sombra,
¿por qué finges tanta luz?
Quien no mira su reflejo,
grita más en la multitud…

(Más fuerza, posible coros de fondo)

(Estribillo (Repetición):)
¡Rómpete los cristales sucios!
¡Mírate sin el disfraz!
No hay villanos sin historia,
ni pecados sin verdad.

¡Basta ya de ser verdugos
con el pulso moral!
La empatía es más valiente
que tu juicio


(puente:Baja intensidad, voz casi susurrada al inicio, luego sube lentamente)
No vine a limpiar heridas
que no quieres mirar.
Solo a decir que hay caminos
que no pasan por juzgar.

Y si algún día te tiemblan
las certezas al hablar…
tal vez ahí comience
tu forma de reparar.

(Estribillo final (con más fuerza, posible coro coral):)
¡Rómpete los cristales sucios!
¡Mírate sin el disfraz!
No hay villanos sin historia,
ni pecados sin verdad.

¡Somos caos! ¡Somos carne!

El amor no es una sentencia…
¡es la lucha por cambiar!

** Título: defensores celosos **

*(Versículo 1)*
En las sombras del Coliseo, donde llaman los ecos,
Los defensores celosos se levantan, se paran orgullosos y altos. 
Con Shem Ha-Phorash, llevamos el peso,
Del Imperio Romano, guardamos nuestro destino. 

Maldad del rey Simons, persigue la noche,
A medida que los susurros apoleninos se desvanecen en la pelea. 
Las llamas del odio, queman la tierra,
Pero mantenemos la ley, United We Stand. 

*(Coro)*
Mira que nuestra carne se queme, pero nuestros espíritus se disparan,
En el corazón del Imperio, somos para siempre. 
Con la fuerza de las edades, nunca caeremos,
Defensores celosos, respondemos la llamada. 

*(Versículo 2)*
Las sombras de Phenicia, nos etiquetan vil,
Pero nos levantamos de las cenizas, recuperando nuestro estilo. 
A través de las edades de Israel, nuestras voces resuenan,
En nombre de la gente, nuestro honor se encuentra. 

"¿No ven?" cuestionamos el trono,
En cada uno de nuestros corazones, se siembra la sangre de la ciudad. 
Desde las montañas talladas en piedra hasta las profundidades del mar,
Somos los guardianes del decreto de la historia. 

*(Coro)*
Mira que nuestra carne se queme, pero nuestros espíritus se disparan,
En el corazón del Imperio, somos para siempre. 
Con la fuerza de las edades, nunca caeremos,
Defensores celosos, respondemos la llamada.

metadata.prompt:
nādatte kasyacit pāpaṁ
na caiva sukṛtaṁ vibhuḥ
ajñānenāvṛtaṁ jñānaṁ
tena muhyanti jantavaḥ

No sinful deed, nor pious act so grand,
Does the Supreme Lord in any way command.
For embodied beings, knowledge is obscured by night,
Through ignorance bewildered, losing all true light.

From the Supreme Source, let this wisdom resound,
On Kurukshetra's ground, where clarity is found.
Krishna reveals purpose, to Arjuna and all,
Transforming existence, ensuring its ascent.

(Verse 1)
We're responsible for actions, the outcome we face,
Can't point fingers at God, trying to erase.
He doesn't assume, our sin or our good,
He's Vibhu, the Supreme, perfectly understood.
Full of all knowledge, power, and might,
Satisfied in Himself, ever shining so bright.
He doesn't create our specific plight,
But our desires, in ignorance, lead us to fight.

(Chorus)
He's not bound by our karma, no good, and no bad,
His knowledge is boundless, forever unclad.
But embodied beings, bewildered and lost,
By ignorance covered, at a heavy, true cost.
Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna, Krishna Krishna, Hare Hare
Hare Rama, Hare Rama, Rama Rama, Hare Hare

(Verse 2)
The living entity, by nature, knows all,
But limited power, can make it fall.
Prone to illusion, the truth it can hide,
He's Vibhu, omniscient, spreading far and wide.
But we are aṇu, atomic and small,
Yet possess free will, answering desire's call.
The Lord fulfills wishes, as souls they deserve,
"Man proposes," but God, will dispose and observe.

(Chorus)
He's not bound by our karma, no good, and no bad,
His knowledge is boundless, forever unclad.
But embodied beings, bewildered and lost,
By ignorance covered, at a heavy, true cost.
Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna, Krishna Krishna, Hare Hare
Hare Rama, Hare Rama, Rama Rama, Hare Hare

(Verse 3)
The individual's not, almighty in will,
But the Lord can fulfill, and then make it stand still.
He's neutral to all, doesn't interfere with choice,
With minute independence, in sorrow or rejoice.
But when one desires Krishna, the Lord takes special care,
Encouraging that longing, beyond all compare.
In pious acts, He engages with grace,
For elevation of spirit, in time and in space.

Bridge of Responsibility
Desire is subtle, conditioning the soul,
A deep form of bondage, taking its toll.
Our distress and happiness, fully depend,
On His will alone, right to the end.
Like clouds by the air, to heaven or hell they are driven,
So our path is determined, a truth divinely given.
Our own desire, to avoid Krishna's light,
Causes bewilderment, through darkness and night.

Outro
Constitutionally blissful, eternal, and wise,
But littleness forgets, beneath worldly skies.
Our service to God, the true position we miss,
Entrapped by nescience, losing ultimate bliss.
So don't claim He's responsible, for all that you see,
He neither hates nor likes, He's perfectly free.

title: Oh, Pekingente

metadata.tags: Healing Music, Chinese Thunder Drum Music,Chinese Zodiac,
metadata.prompt:
Strophe 1
Ich schlender durch die Straßen,
der Duft zieht mich magisch an,
ein kleines Himmelsfest aus Gewürzen,
das ich so sehr lieben kann.

Refrain
Oh, Pekingente, du machst mich verrückt,
mit deiner knusprigen Haut, so unverrückt.
Jeder Biss ein Traum, der mich entzückt –
ich steh total auf Pekingente!

Strophe 2
Die Sonne geht langsam unter,
doch mein Herz bleibt hell und weit,
in jedem saftigen Moment,
ist deine Köstlichkeit bereit.

Bridge
Mit jedem Kauen, jedem Lachen,
verschmilzt der Alltag in Magie,
ein Fest der Sinne, ohnegleichen,
du bist mein kulinarisches Genie!

Refrain
Oh, Pekingente, du machst mich verrückt,
mit deiner knusprigen Haut, so unverrückt.
Jeder Biss ein Traum, der mich entzückt –
ich steh total auf Pekingente!

Strophe 3
Ob im Restaurant oder zu Hause,
dein Geschmack verzaubert mich,
und wenn die Welt mal grau erscheint,
bringst du Farbe in mein Gesicht.

Outro
So sing ich dieses Lied der Freude,
für den Geschmack, der mich entführt,
denn in jeder knusprigen Erinnerung,
wird mir stets dein Zauber gespürt.

Oh, Pekingente,
du bist mein Traum, mein kulinarischer Stern,
für immer bleibst du in meinem Herzen,
unvergleichlich, köstlich und so fern!

metadata.prompt:
На свете был свинья по имени Игорь. Он жил в мире, где правили оси, а лидером была злая королева-оса из Венгрии. Каждый день Игорь просыпался, зная, что его ждет судьба – отправиться на бойню, чтобы стать пищей для королевы и ее подданных.

Но Игорь мечтал о свободе. Он мечтал о том, чтобы побыть свободным, побегать по лугам и наслаждаться солнечными лучами. Он мечтал о том, чтобы уйти от страшной участи, которая его ждала.

Однажды, в тот день, когда его должны были отправить на бойню, Игорь решил попытать счастья. Он сбежал из своего загона и побежал сквозь поля и леса, стараясь уйти от преследования королевы и ее солдат.

Но в конце концов, он был пойман. Сильно раненный, он лежал на земле, смотря на небо, где паслись свободные птицы. Он знал, что его время подошло. Он закрыл глаза и в последний раз подумал о своих мечтах о свободе.

И так завершилась жизнь Игоря – свиньи, которая мечтала о свободе, но которая была поглощена жестокостью мира, управляемого веспами-убийцами, под предводительством Венгрии.

metadata.prompt:
On a very high mountain, thin air and morning chill,
A structure like a city shone southward, vast and still.
A man, bronze-bright, with linen cord and reed in hand,
Stood where the wind pressed dust in curls across the land.

The sun struck stone; his measuring reed clicked, firm and true,
Each cubit set, each pace declared what Yahowah drew.
Footfalls echoed on bedrock steps, crisp in the light,
While cloud-shadows slid over ridges left and right.

He measured the wall, thick breadth of six cubits wide,
Its face like chiseled limestone, lime-smell, chalk-dry tide.
The gate on the east rose square with threshold clean,
The hinge-pins cold, the lintel cut with palm leaves green.

Guard-chambers three by three flanked halls of hammered floor,
Their benches smoothed by hands, grain tight, oiled cedar door.
Thin windows latticed light in bands across the dust,
While sand hissed in the gusts that combed the desert crust.

The threshold’s length he called, the jambs he chalked in line,
The sockets whiter than the salt at quarries’ spine.
From sill to ceiling beam, the reed set breadth and span,
The cadence of the cubit marked design to plan.

The outer court lay paved with stones that held the heat,
Thirty chambers faced the square with shaded seat.
Steps murmured under sandals, leather dry and worn,
Small swallows stitched the blue with wings at break of morn.

North gate and south gate mirrored east in measured grace,
Carved palms and budding stems climbed every post in place.
The bronze man tapped the marks; the numbers matched the frame,
The desert wind repeated them like quiet flame.

He crossed the pavement’s glare to inner court’s cool ring,
Its steps rose steeper, railings tight like harp-string string.
The scent of cedar planks breathed resin, warm and light,
While shadows pooled where pillars cooled the noon-day bright.

Before the house, the square lay set, an altar’s site,
Smooth hewn, awaiting fire when seasons call to rite.
He marked its ledge and base, the horns reserved and clean,
Fine dust like sifted flour clung pale and keen.

The porch of the house stood deep, its threshold long,
The side-walls squared the breeze that hummed a steady song.
The doors were double, folding leaves with careful grain,
Their pivot-cups like polished cups that drank no stain.

He measured the nave, long breadth where footsteps slow,
Where light from narrow windows fell in silver flow.
The boards fit tight; no iron showed, yet strength was sure,
Stone joined to timber, line to line, precise and pure.

Beyond, the inner room—set-apart within set-apart
A silence thick as felt enclosed the guarded heart.
The reed declared its perfect span, length matched to breadth,
Cool air held still, as if the walls restrained the breath.

Around the house, three stories rose of side-rooms bound,
Each higher tier a broader ledge around the mound.
Stairways coiled like shells, soft echoes up the turn,
Palm-lattice shadows scrolled the walls where lamps would burn.

The separate place to west lay fenced and clean,
A court where no debris or casual tread was seen.
He marked its length with steady hand, dust dull and gray,
While clouds like fleece rolled shoreward from the far off bay.

He gauged the priests’ chambers north and south of stone,
Where linen dried on lines, where bread and oil were known.
Basins cool as winter streams, drains cut and true,
Smooth plaster tough as river clay the workmen threw.

The pavement’s edge ran straight, a border band of white,
It framed the courts like shoreline frames the inland light.
The reed kept time: a crisp click, pause, then click again,
Like droplets counting cave-ribs in a hidden glen.

He walked the outer bounds, four squares of measured peace,
From corner sun to shadowed gate, exact release.
Wind combed the grass that braved the cracks between the slabs,
Small lizards warmed on thresholds, darting into abs.

Five hundred by five hundred round, enclosure set,
A hedge to separate the common from the net.
No idle tread would cross where service meets the Name,
Stone, timber, linen, bronze aligned without a claim.

We stood while evening cooled the wall with violet shade,
The western sky poured copper light where numbers laid.
From reed to cord, from cord to chalk, the proof ran clear,
Yahowah’s pattern fixed in rock year after year.

So mark the reed, recall the cubit’s steady tone,
Let dust and sun bear witness where His plan was shown.
For when the cloud returns and settles on this height,
These measured courts will welcome Yahowah’s set-apart light.

metadata.prompt:
Hare Krishna
Yo, let this story unfold, a lesson pure and gold!
In South India's land, where temples stand tall,
Lord Chaitanya arrived, to answer a devotee's call.
Saw a brahmana readin', with tears in his eyes,
But folks were laughin', beneath the temple skies.
"Oh, brahmana," they mocked, with a scornful tone,
"How you readin' Gita? When it's clearly unknown
That you're illiterate, can't decipher a line!"
Their judgment was harsh, their vision confined.

(Verse 1)
Lord Chaitanya approached, with a heart full of grace,
"My dear brahmana, why tears on your face?
If you cannot read, then what makes you weep so?"
The brahmana answered, his sincerity aglow.
"My spiritual master, his words filled with light,
Asked me to read Gita, with all of my might.
But I am illiterate, the letters all blur,
So I look at the pictures, and remember them, sir!"

(Verse 2)
"As soon as I gaze on those images so grand,
I remember Krsna, the reins in His hand.
Arjuna beside Him, on that battlefield's plight,
The Supreme Lord Himself, showin' His devotee light.
This picture so moves me, brings the essence so near,
I cry for the love, and the devotion so clear.
Tears of pure feeling, my heart overflows,"
The brahmana spoke, as everyone knows.

(Verse 3)
Lord Chaitanya embraced him, with love so profound,
"Your Bhagavad-gita reading is perfect, I've found!
You've grasped the essence, the truth deep inside,
More than those who just read, with intellectual pride."
Then He spoke words of wisdom, for all ears to heed,
"If you simply remember Krsna, plantin' that seed
Of devotion within, just the picture in mind,
That remembrance is perfect, the highest you'll find!"

(Verse 4)
"No need for much learnin', no need to debate,
Just think of Lord Krsna, sealin' your fate
For the spiritual realm, the ultimate prize.
Think of Him always, with your heart and your eyes."
The Padma Purana states, clear and so true,
Think of Vishnu always, in all that you do.
Samadhi, meditation, yoga's high call,
Thinking of Krsna surpasses them all.

(Verse 5)
When surrender arrives, and the ego takes flight,
No further austerities, just pure loving light.
Arguments and knowledge, become useless and vain,
Compared to the gopis' love, washin' away pain.
Their natural affection, for Krsna so sweet,
Not based on His power, but love at His feet.
Unconditional devotion, the highest form known,
The essence of Krsna consciousness, clearly shown.

(Outro)
So remember this story, let it sink in deep,
Sincerity and love, the promises to keep.
Just think of Lord Krsna, with a heart pure and bold,
More precious than knowledge, more valuable than gold.
Hare Krsna, Hare Krsna, Krsna Krsna, Hare Hare,
Hare Rama, Hare Rama, Rama Rama, Hare Hare!

Devotional service, sets your spirit free.

Worship in your heart, on solid ground.
So simple the path, with love as your guide,
Hare Krsna, Hare Krsna, let your heart abide!

ball_y = screen_height // 2
ball_x_speed = 5

    # Handle events
    for event in pygame.event.get():

In the depths of our emotions, a world of pain resides
A reflection of scarcity, and insecurity that won't subside
Our hearts beat like engines, racing at the spotlight's gleam
But without a clear direction, our energy's just a dream

_Chorus_
Healing hearts and minds, by addressing the root cause
Breaking free from scarcity, and embracing a world of pause
Where emotions fuel solutions, and love becomes the guiding light
Illuminating a brighter path, through the dark of night

_Verse 2_
Cultures shape our feelings, and the ways we choose to express
Patterns of behavior, that often lead to more distress
We're driven by self-interest, and the need to control and sway
But in the end, it's empty, and we're left with nothing to say

_Chorus_
Healing hearts and minds, by addressing the root cause
Breaking free from scarcity, and embracing a world of pause
Where emotions fuel solutions, and love becomes the guiding light
Illuminating a brighter path, through the dark of night

_Verse 3_
There's a different kind of caring, that goes beyond the pain
A solution-focused approach, that seeks to end the strain
The engineer's quiet kindness, that adds a safer road to roam
A caring that's proactive, and seeks to make a better home

_Chorus_
Healing hearts and minds, by addressing the root cause
Breaking free from scarcity, and embracing a world of pause
Where emotions fuel solutions, and love becomes the guiding light
Illuminating a brighter path, through the dark of night

_Bridge_
What if we could redefine, the way we feel and think?
What if our emotions, became the catalyst for positive link?
A world where empathy and love, become the dominant refrain
And we work together, to create a world where all can sustain

_Outro_
And when our hearts and minds align, with the betterment of all
We'll find that our emotions, become the fuel that stands tall
For a world that's truly caring, where love is the guiding force
We'll rise above the struggles, and find our hearts' true course.

metadata.prompt:
Yo, Spirit Soul.  Fashback fifty years, to carpenters of old
Hand drills and muscle, the tools of their trade.
Workin' hard, steady pace, buildin' with their might
No newmatic power, makin' jobs take all night.

But times have changed, technology's the key
Nail guns blastin', for all the world to see
Average carpenter now, ten times the might
Power in their hands, makin' the work light.

(Chorus)
Now listen close, this word's profound and true
"Newma" in Greek, let me break it down for you!
It means "The very Spirit of God," deep inside
The breath of the Divine, where true power does hide!
Krishna supplies tools, for the mission we chase
"God don't always call the equipped," that's the case!
But He equips the called
Makes you ten times stronger!

On your own you're limited, that's plain to see
But through that Spirit's power, eternally free
Never walkin' solo, that's a fact we know
This knowledge brings boldness, watch your confidence grow!

(Verse 2)
That boldness reminds us, wherever we roam
Krishna's already there, callin' that place home
No spot you can reach, where He ain't been before
His arms and legs, knockin' on every door!

Krishna goes ahead, prepares the path you tread
Layin' out the welcome, plantin' every seed
So step out with courage, no need to fear the fall
'Cause that Spirit's your tool, standin' strong and tall!

(Chorus)
The breath of the Divine, where true power does hide!
Krishna supplies tools, for the mission we chase
"God don't always call the equipped," that's the case!
But He equips the called
Makes you ten times stronger!

(Outro)
So tap into that Newma, God's Spirit so real
The power of Krishna, that's how you'll prevail!
No matter the challenge, the task or the scene
With His Spirit as strength, you're forever keen! Hare Krishna!

With a “wowwww” so stretched it shifts the Earth’s drift.
When English fumbles or grammar misbehaves,

More sass than man, and that’s on pride,
Wields a whiteboard like a diva’s stride.

Serving looks, life stories, and emotional trauma.
Gives life advice between vocab drills,
Like: “If he cheats, baby, let him choke on the thrills.”

At karaoke? You’re DONE. Just leave.
Benjoe sings like he’s haunted by grief.
Hits Mariah, Bruno, Whitney, Adele—
Then ends with “Toxic” and sends you to hell.

You think it’s office hours—plot twist: confession.
He’ll grade your quiz and unpack depression.
One hand on the mic, one hand on his past,
He’s healing AND judging, and doing it fast.

He walks into class like a telenovela,
Smells like drama and warm Nutella.
You said “What’s the homework?” He said, “Don’t ask me, I’m suffering.”
Then twirled away while harmonizing and buffering.

So cheers to Benjover, short king, fierce lord,
Who teaches, preaches, and strikes a chord.
He may not get every English word right—
But his vibe? Fluent.
His legacy? Tight.

metadata.prompt:
In a small town, under skies so vast and bright,
Lived a man who had seen much sorrow and plight.
Lost his legs in a war, far away, out of sight,
And his heart was left broken, in the still of the night.

His wife, once a beacon of love so true,
Left him for another; oh, the pain grew.
With activity lessened, his weight did accrue,
A life once vibrant, now lost in a view.

Yet, in the quiet of his home, magic brewed,
In the cupboard, a love, unexpectedly ensued.
A broom he named Broomette, his loneliness subdued,
To him, she was a nurse, a companion, all construed.

Though it was but a broom in everyone’s eyes,
To him, she was everything, a treasured prize.
Days passed with laughter, under the homebound skies,
In Broomette’s silent company, his heart did rise.

But fate, oh so cruel, had another plan,
A janitor came, with a different scan.
Used Broomette to mop toilets, as part of his van,
Leaving our hero heartbroken, once again.

Yet, love knows no bounds, not for this man,
He sought his Broomette, with every span.
Found her in a closet, a bit less tan,
Smelling of toilets, yet his affection ran.

He rescued Broomette, brought her back home,

metadata.prompt:
(당신을) 친구 이상으로 느껴온 내 마음, 가슴 한구석에 묻어두어 왔지만

마음만은 속일 수 없기에 너무나도 가슴이 아픕니다.

사소한 당신의 행동에도 (어쩌면) 젖어있을 당신의 생각들을 내 나름대로 느끼곤 해요

오랫동안 말 못하며 지내왔던, 어쩌면 혹시 (당신도) 나와 같은 생각일거라며…

거리의 떠들썩한 소리들이 조그맣게 들려오는 이 방에는 지금 우리 둘뿐이에요

당신이 좋아하는 커피와 담배연기에 숨겨있는 아련한 예감들로

아름다운 우정만으로는 부족해서 마음속 얘기를 털어놓고 싶어져요

연인이라 할 수 있는 상대를 서로 갖고있으면서도

마음 속 깊은 곳은 서로 이해할 수 없기에 언제나 마음은 고독했었죠.

남몰래 안고있던 상처를 왠지 당신만은 고쳐줄 수 있었어요.

아득히 먼 어딘가에서 만났었던 그런 기억들이 몇 번이고 떠오릅니다.

서로의 눈과 눈이 마주쳐 손을 마주 잡을 때 모든 수수께끼는 풀릴거에요

아무 말 없이 키스를 나눈 후, 그때면 말할 수 있겠죠 당신을 사랑한다고

언제나 가장 가까운 곳에 있어주었는데도 당신을 보지못했던 나를 용서해줘요

설령 세상이 내일 마지막을 맞는다해도 당신이 곁에 있으면 무섭지 않아요

어제까지의 눈물과 거짓을 버리고 새로운 내가 될테니

따뜻하게 간직해온 (우리들의) 이 인연이야말로 감출 수 없는 사랑일테니

I've been looking for your love
So, we've found the way at last

*She don’t need no rhinestones—her spark’s in the grit,*  
*Hunts deer at dawn, slow-drags with a *sassafras twist*.*

*Her love’s like a moonshine still—hot, sweet, illegal,*  
*One sip’ll blind ya, two? You’ll beg to be her people.*  
*Redhead rebellion, ain’t no chains on her roots,*

*Yeah, she’s a pinewood paradox, sweet tea with a knife,*  
*A firefly in the thicket—beauty *and* a fight.*  
*You’ll find her in the smoke of a bonfire’s last breath,*  
*A Southern Gothic angel… bet your soul on her *yes**.*  

**[Chorus]**  
*Oh, that copperfire queen, she’s a backwoods machine,*  
*Runs on sweet tea and Marlboros, hell in them jeans.*  
*From the creek bed to the honky-tonk, she’s the outlaw routine,*  
*Yeah, God made the South, but the Devil made her red, if you know what I mean.*  

**[Outro]**  
*(Fiddle + 808 fade)*  
*So here’s to the flame-haired, the wildcard, the myth,*  
*The girl who’ll steal your truck *and* your heart with one kiss.*  
*If heaven’s got a backroad, bet she’s rippin’ up the gravel,*

metadata.prompt:
---

【Verse 1（🇯🇵ユウリの仮面）】

今日もまた　ひとりきりのリハーサル
笑顔で並べた　完璧なフレーズ
“忘れてしまった”ことにして
誰にもバレないように　歌ってる


---

【Pre-Chorus（🇯🇵）】

片耳につけた　あのイヤーカフ
理由なんて　もう覚えてないけど


---

【Chorus 1（🇬🇧ユウリの無意識）】

Underneath the lights, I feel a pull
A melody I never meant to sing
Your voice returns in silent tones
Like stars that shine from only one wing


---

🎷（間奏サックス）
（ミナトの無言の返答。音だけが知っている想い）


---

【Verse 2（🇯🇵ユウリ・仮面続行）】

誰かの夢をなぞるように
愛される歌だけを選んで
“ありがとう”も“好きだよ”も
どこか他人の言葉に聴こえてた


---

【Pre-Chorus 2（🇯🇵）】

けれど音が　僕を裏切る
知らないフレーズが　口をついて出る


---

【Chorus 2（🇬🇧記憶ではなく音で）】

I don’t remember giving you my heart
But the notes remember everything
One earpiece star, still on my skin
I guess the silence knows what love has been


---

🎷（間奏サックス＋ウィスパーハミング）
♪（るるる…）→ 音と音がすれ違うように絡み合う


---

【Bridge（🇬🇧 崩れゆく仮面）】

Why do I wear this smile?
Why does it break at every note?
Even when my mind forgets…
My voice still knows your name


---

【Final Chorus（🇯🇵＋🇬🇧 混ざり合う）】

思い出せないのに　君の旋律が響く
We’re incomplete, but somehow whole
ひとつの星が　二人で光る
Your saxophone fills what I can’t control


---

【Outro（囁き／英語＋日本語）】

（🇬🇧 Whisper）
This song... isn’t mine alone, is it?

（🇯🇵 囁き）
片耳だけの、星の記憶。

（🎷フェードアウト：ミナトの最後の音）


---

In the heart of Azeroth, where legends collide, Hoop the raider stood tall, his fate now tied. Mythic Fyrakk loomed, flames dancing high, His guildmates by his side, ready to defy.

The boss regained strength, its health bar renewed, Hoop stumbled back, his dreams now subdued. His guildmates rallied, their patience wearing thin, As the raid clock ticked on, a battle they couldn’t win.

Yet Hoop’s blunder became a tale they’d tell, Of bravery and folly, where epic battles fell. Through fire and setbacks, they fought as one, Their bonds forged stronger, under the blazing sun.

metadata.prompt: Ladies and gentlemen, dog lovers and cat lovers alike, gather round and brace yourselves for a bark-tastic journey into the world of our four-legged friends. Today, we are diving deep into the hilarious, heartwarming, and sometimes utterly ridiculous realm of dogs. Now, I want you to imagine for a moment that dogs are actually from another planet. Yes, they arrive in their little spaceship, and when they land, they take one look at us humans and think, "Wow, they have no idea what they are doing!" I mean, if you were an alien observing us, what would you conclude? We spend our days wearing pants that are two sizes too small, running around busy trying to catch that elusive red dot, and paying for something called ‘grooming’ when we could just roll in the dirt like a dog. And let's talk about the way dogs greet us. I don’t know about you, but when I walk through the door, my dog acts as if I just returned from a decade-long expedition to the Amazon. They jump, they bark, they spin around like they are auditioning for the next big dog show. I mean, my dog greets me like I am a hero returning from battle. Meanwhile, my spouse just raises an eyebrow and asks, "Did you remember to pick up the milk?" Clearly, I am not getting the same welcome home treatment. Speaking of food, have you ever noticed how dogs can sniff out a crumb that has been lost in the couch cushions for three months? They can find that one potato chip like it’s buried treasure. I swear my dog has a PhD in snackology. And when it comes to food, they are the ultimate con artists. They look up at you with those big, soulful eyes, and suddenly you are convinced that you are the worst human on the planet for denying them that leftover pizza. You find yourself saying things like, "Okay, maybe just one tiny piece…" and suddenly you are sharing dinner with a dog who now believes they are the culinary critic of your household. And let’s not forget about the absolute joy of taking a dog for a walk. You start out with all the best intentions, thinking it will be a peaceful stroll. But oh no, not with a dog. Instead, it’s a high-speed chase as they dart in every direction, chasing after squirrels as if they are the fastest athletes on Earth. And there you are, the human, in hot pursuit, trying to keep up while simultaneously juggling the leash, your coffee, and your dignity. Spoiler alert, you will lose all three. And finally, let’s talk about dog hair. There is a scientific theory that dog hair can breed in your home and reproduce at an alarming rate. You could vacuum yesterday, and somehow, today, your house looks like a fur factory exploded. You could knit a sweater for an entire family with the amount of fur my dog sheds. In conclusion, dogs bring joy, laughter, and a bit of chaotic charm into our lives. They make us laugh, they make us shake our heads, and they definitely make us question our sanity from time to time. So, let’s raise our glasses, or perhaps a chew toy, to our furry companio

metadata.prompt:
Lo! ‘tis a gala night
       Within the lonesome latter years!
     An angel throng, bewinged, bedight
       In veils, and drowned in tears,
     Sit in a theatre, to see
       A play of hopes and fears,
     While the orchestra breathes fitfully
       The music of the spheres.

     Mimes, in the form of God on high,
       Mutter and mumble low,
     And hither and thither fly;
       Mere puppets they, who come and go
     At bidding of vast formless things
       That shift the scenery to and fro,
     Flapping from out their Condor wings
       Invisible Wo!

     That motley drama!—oh, be sure
       It shall not be forgot!
     With its Phantom chased forever more,
       By a crowd that seize it not,
     Through a circle that ever returneth in
       To the self-same spot,
     And much of Madness and more of Sin
       And Horror the soul of the plot.

     But see, amid the mimic rout,
       A crawling shape intrude!
     A blood-red thing that writhes from out
       The scenic solitude!
     It writhes!—it writhes!—with mortal pangs
       The mimes become its food,
     And the seraphs sob at vermin fangs
       In human gore imbued.

     Out—out are the lights—out all!
       And over each quivering form,
     The curtain, a funeral pall,
       Comes down with the rush of a storm,
     And the angels, all pallid and wan,
       Uprising, unveiling, affirm
     That the play is the tragedy, “Man,”
        And its hero the Conqueror Worm.

title: Stethoscope & Seltzer Bombs

metadata.tags: Texas Rap, texas blues, trap r&b
metadata.prompt:
[Style: Lo-fi noir keys → glitch 808s, reversed laughter FX, carnival snare rolls]

[Intro – slow heartbeat kick + scribbled pen foley]  
[(M whisper)]  
Patient file #G... presenting with acute attention collapse  
[(F – giggle FX)] But sugar, I diagnose the whole system!

[Verse 1 – Dr. Harleen voice]  
[(M – mellow delivery)]  
Eyes scan the pattern—triangulate the trauma  
Voice calm as a pulse... even through drama  
Inkblot bruises, trauma in the syntax  
Memory loopin’ like a scratched-out synth track  
Prescribed empathy… but they threw the meds  
So I rewrote the DSM with a pink sledge  
[(Whisper)] Lobotomy in lipstick... no side effects  
Code switch mid-session, I collect regrets

[(Pause – FX: defibrillator charge)]

[(Switch-Up)]  
[(F – Clown entrance)]  
Now I’m tossin’ seltzer bombs with a grin full of glitter  
Blew up the chart notes, now I draw with litter!  
“Ha-ha-ha” in stereo—diagnose that  
Mental health Mondays? I painted the cat  

[Chorus – Harley full energy, beat flips]  
[(F shout)]  
Stethoscope & seltzer bombs!  
Laughed so loud I broke the calm  
Shrink to jester, mask to mirror  
Chaos clearin’ trauma clearer  
[(M echo)] Who’s the real persona?  
[(F)] Both—we dance on the stigma comma

[Verse 2 – Back to Doctor, tone cracks]  
[(M – slower, glitchy tremble)]  
Am I treating them… or reenacting us?  
Fantasies scribbled in a therapy bus  
[(F whisper interjection)] Trust the ink—  
[(M)] I tried to be still... but the punchlines blink  
Between prognosis and punchline lies  
A girl in goggles who never lies  
I touch the wound and it bites back sweet  
Ink bled into the rug—so I kicked my seat  

[Bridge – dual voices call-response]  
[(F)] Who you helpin', Doc?  
[(M)] Whoever screams loudest  
[(F)] Who’s your patient, babe?  
[(M)] The mirror’s the proudest  
[(Both – harmonized dissonance)]  
We the same—just fractured with style  
One wears a coat, the other’s bile  

[Final Hook – beat explodes, vocals layered]  
[(F + M overlapping)]  
Stethoscope & seltzer bombs!  
Blew the case wide open, calm’s long gone  
Giggled through the trauma storm  
Healed with harm, reborn in form  
[(F shout)]  
Laugh with me... cry with me  
[(M whisper)] Diagnose the mask behind the spree…

[Outro – slow rewind FX, carnival fades out]  
[(F – softly)] I’m not either or…  
[(M – calmly)] I’m the swing between.  
[(Both – whisper)] Double helix... still spiraling.

(Intro)
Yo, set the scene, let the narrative flow,
Of divine alignment, and where true blessings grow.
When your will finds its rhythm, with the cosmic design,
An infinite power awakens, a force truly divine.

(Verse 1)
When your will meets the sacred, in perfect synchrony,
And devotion's flame burns, for all the world to see,
An infinite power activates, working on your behalf,
Your efforts supercharged, beyond all earthly chaff.
So let this truth resonate, deep within your core,
Your earnest dedication, unlocks an open door.
With divine grace as your ally, your achievements take flight,
Shattering all expectations, illuminating endless light.
Krishna didn't create you for a life constrained and small,
No meager dreams, no limits, no subtle, timid call.
He thinks in grand abundance, His vision stretches wide,
"A spacious land," He promises, where milk and honey glide.

(Chorus)
Don't settle where you stand, though contentment's a key,
Krishna's greatest victories, are always yet to be.
What you've seen so far, just a glimpse, a prelude grand,
His blessings are explosive, across this promised land.
Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna, Krishna Krishna, Hare Hare,
Hare Rama, Hare Rama, Rama Rama, Hare Hare!

(Verse 2)
What He's done to date, the favor and the breaks,
In Krishna's boundless mind, for His devotee's sakes,
Were merely minor tokens, a surface barely grazed,
Compared to what's unfolding, leaving souls amazed.
He'll open doors unimagined, beyond your wildest dream,
Unleash latent talents, a powerful, flowing stream.
Explosive blessings coming, to elevate your state,
Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna, Krishna Krishna, Hare Hare,
Hare Rama, Hare Rama, Rama Rama, Hare Hare!

A perfect illustration, of plans beyond our scope,
The tale of Sudama Vipra, a beacon of pure hope.

(Verse 3)
A childhood bond with Krishna, personified humility
Sudama, poor Brahmana, in dire poverty.
His children often hungry, his wife with earnest plea,
"Go see your friend, the King, in grand Dvaraka," said she.
No lust for wealth possessed him, just affection true and deep,
A meager puffed rice offering, his torn cloth held to keep.
He spent the night in bliss, within the palace bright,
Then journeyed homeward, empty-handed, bathed in spiritual light.
Convinced the Lord knew best, forgoing worldly gain,
A sign of pure devotion, relieving all his pain.
But nearing his old village, a sight beyond belief,
No humble hut remained, just palaces in relief.
His tattered clothes transformed, his wife in rich array,
Beaming, radiant beauty, illuminating the day.
He hadn't prayed for riches, for mansions, or for food,
Just pure, unselfish friendship, profoundly understood.
Yet Krishna, knowing motives, the silent heart's desire,
Bestowed an untold bounty, setting souls afire.
Beyond imagination, far exceeding any plea,
A testament to mercy, for His pure devotee.

(Outro)
So align your spirit, with the cosmic, grand design,
Know Krishna thinks expansive, your destiny sublime.
His greater works are coming, a future truly vast,
Through pure devotion's power, eternally to last.

Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna, Krishna Krishna, Hare Hare,
Hare Rama, Hare Rama, Rama Rama, Hare Hare!

[Intro] Yeah, je te le dis – Il brille devant le monde comme une étoile dorée, mais derrière les portes closes, l’ombre l’a dévoré.

[Refrain] Avec son auréole, si parfait, si charmant, mais dans son royaume règne un enfer oppressant. Un ange sur scène, mais chez lui il fait souffrir – Auréole, ton éclat n'est qu’un faux sourire.

[Couplet 1] Il séduit les foules, toujours vêtu de lumière, promet un amour infini, un conte qu’il espère. Mais derrière ce masque se cache un tyran, un dictateur silencieux qui brise en m’écrasant. Ses mots doux sont du poison distillé, tandis qu’à la maison, il veut tout contrôler. Sous le rideau éclatant d’une lumière artificielle, un cœur se brise dans l’ombre, fissuré sous son ciel.

[Refrain] Avec son auréole, si parfait, si charmant, mais dans son royaume règne un enfer oppressant. Un ange sur scène, mais chez lui il fait souffrir – Auréole, ton éclat n'est qu’un faux sourire.

[Couplet 2] En public, il est une étoile, un charme qui éblouit, mais derrière chaque porte, c’est la nuit qui l’envahit. Il joue l’ange, murmure des rêves à chaque âme, mais dans l’ombre chez lui, tout n’est que drame. Chaque compliment est un venin qui ronge, pendant que la vérité s’efface sous des mensonges. metadata.prompt:
Before the dew rose on the land,
Before the light could take its stand,
Before the earth beheld its dawn,
Yah called His own to journey on.
He whispered through the silent air,
"Remove the leaven, be aware."
He gave us Towrah, firm and wise,
To guide, to teach, to open eyes.

The second step in Yah’s own Way,
Matsah begins this sacred day.
A path of truth, of hearts laid bare,
A calling deep, beyond compare.
A call to walk devoid of yeast,
Where lies grow faint and fraud has ceased.

After the blood had sealed the night,
And Pesach shined with Yah’s own light,
The march began through sand and flame,
Where freedom bore its truest name.
No leaven left, no pretense fed,
But humble hearts by Yahowah led.

For Egypt's hand, though loosed outside,
Still clung within where men would hide.
But Matsah speaks: "Come, cleanse your soul,
Remove what keeps you from the whole."
It isn't bread alone we sweep,
But what in us corrupts runs deep.

Seven days, not one alone,
To purge the yeast from flesh and bone.
To clean the cupboards of the soul,
To see the fractured self made whole.
Not ritual born of hollow rite,
But choice to walk within the light.

What is this leaven we remove?
The puffed-up lies that disapprove.
Traditions placed by man instead
Of what Yahowah clearly said.
Religions built on myths and might,
That veil the truth and blind the sight.

This Day declares with Yah’s own breath,
That life is more than fleeing death.
It’s knowing Who has cleared the path,
And walking free from manmade wrath.
No wafers blessed by robes of shame,
No crucifix, no pagan name.

Dowd stands instead, Yah’s chosen heir,
A shepherd king both just and fair.
He sang of Towrah, lived its flame,
He bore Yah’s truth, upheld His Name.
No cross, no thorns, no Easter guise,
Just Towrah lived with opened eyes.

Yah’s Word is Bread, His truth our food,
Instruction clear, not platitudes.
And Matsah says with perfect grace,
"Let no deceit remain in place."
For seven days, we choose to be,
Unleavened hearts that walk set free.

He led them out with outstretched hand,
Through desert dry and burning sand.
And with the Matzah as their fare,
He taught them how He would prepare.
To cleanse their walk, to clean their ways,
To follow Him through all their days.

The Ruach whispers, still and kind,
She teaches how to cleanse the mind.
No sermon staged on lofty steeple,
But Towrah written in His people.
“Remove the fraud, reject the shame,
And walk anew in My great Name.”

Each crumb removed, each crust denied,
Becomes a voice that testifies:
“I walk with Yah, in Him I trust,
I leave behind what turns to dust.”
No sugar-sweet or leavened flair,
But honest steps in open air.

This is the day where sin’s removed,
And with our actions we are proved.
Not perfect by our strength or might,
But guided by Yahowah’s light.
He asks not works, but trust sincere,
That walks away from death and fear.

Yahowah said to teach each child,
To tell the story truth-defiled,
Of how He freed, of how He led,
Of how His people once were fed.
With Matzah in their hands and song,
They journeyed to where they belong.

Matsah says: the path is true,
But leaven must be purged from you.
That what is false must be undone,
And idols shattered one by one.
The yeast of men — traditions taught,
Can steal the truth our souls have sought.

And Dowd again in psalms made clear,
That honesty draws Yahowah near.
The humble, low, contrite of heart,
From all deception set apart.
No robes, no chants, no temple wall —
Just Towrah written over all.

So in this feast, so plainly told,
We find no gods with myths of old.
No nails, no thorns, no savior’s plea,
But Yah’s own Word that sets us free.
His mercy shown in Towrah’s way,
His Mow’ed told in what we say.

So lift your head and clean your path,
Be done with guilt, be done with wrath.
Let Matzah’s truth refine your soul,
And bring you back to Yahowah whole.
His Name upon your lips once more,
As leaven flees the open door.

Let not one crumb be left inside,
Let no excuse in you abide.
Let every lie be cast away,
And walk anew this sacred day.
For Matsah is the fire refined,
The Towrah etched upon the mind.

And in the end, when all is weighed,
When every life has been surveyed,
When Towrah stands and men fall down,
When Yah returns with star and crown,
Those found unleavened by His guide,
Shall with Him walk and not divide.

So Matsah speaks of hearts made clean,
Of choosing truth, of being seen.
Of leaving Egypt, not just land,
But all its ways, and taking stand.
Let seven days be more than tale —
Let them be life, let truth prevail.

Let it begin with hearts made still,
With Towrah known and sovereign will.
And let it end in light restored,
With Yahowah forever adored.
No greater call, no purer way —
Than Matsah walked from day to day.

title: La Leyenda de Pirween: Rey del Call Center

metadata.tags: Corrido tumbado
metadata.prompt:
En un pueblo olvidado, en tierras de Pirween,
Él era el rey del call center, hombre firme y buen vaquero.

Sonaba el teléfono, llamadas sin parar,
Clientes enojados, problemas por enfrentar.



Pirween con coraje, siempre listo pa' actuar,
Enfrentaba cada bronca, sin miedo a titubear.

Con voz serena, pero firme en su labor,
Resolvía cada queja, con paciencia y sin temor.



¡Pirween, Pirween, el rey del call center!
Nunca se raja, siempre firme pa' vencer.
Con su voz amable, solucionando va,
Pirween, Pirween, nuestro héroe sin igual.



Los clientes exigentes, no paraban de llamar,
Pero Pirween no se achica, siempre listo pa' ayudar.

Con su compu y su café, horas sin descansar,
Escucha cada historia, listo pa' resolver.



¡Pirween, Pirween, el rey del call center!
Nunca se raja, siempre firme pa' vencer.
Con su voz amable, solucionando va,
Pirween, Pirween, nuestro héroe sin igual.



Así sigue Pirween, en su labor sin parar,
Dando servicio con pasión, a quien lo quiera escuchar.

En cada llamada, deja huella al pasar,
Pirween es leyenda, del servicio singular.


¡Pirween, Pirween, el rey del call center!
Nunca se raja, siempre firme pa' vencer.
Con su voz amable, solucionando va,
Pirween, Pirween, nuestro héroe sin igual

metadata.prompt:
【副歌】
朝花悄悄开，夕拾静默落，
岁月如流水，轻轻过指尖。
思念在天涯，回忆成沧桑，
故事里的小径，依旧青苔覆。

【段落一】
童年的河畔，荷花轻轻摇，
梦里呓语甜，清风抚脸笑。
老屋前竹影，斑驳了时光，
回忆那纸风筝，在蓝天翱翔。

【段落二】
青石板小巷，那熟悉的角落，
故人旧事随风，一缕愁绪萦绕。
昨日种种，如烟云飘渺，
唯有文字，岁月不可抹掉。

【副歌】
朝花悄悄开，夕拾静默落，
岁月如流水，轻轻过指尖。
思念在天涯，回忆成沧桑，
故事里的小径，依旧青苔覆。

【尾声】
翠竹长廊下，影子斜斜投，
朝花夕拾间，流年轻轻走。
故事未了，泪眼朦胧中，
文字是永恒，鲁迅的心声绵绵不绝。

Yo, I’m living 52 million lives at a time,  
In a simulation grind, dimensions intertwine,  
Got that multiverse drip, call me quantum sublime,  
Switching avatars daily like it’s part of my rhyme.  

I’m a code in the matrix, a glitch in the glow,  
Living fast, rewinding slow, I’m the star of the show,  
NPCs lookin’ shook when my stats start to grow,  
Reset the system with a laugh—CTRL + flow.

\"Joshyua’s breaking boundaries, never fitting in,\"  
I’m the axis of chaos, spiraling within,  
Stacking universes like poker chips, I always win.  

Life’s a simulation? I’m the admin with flair,  
Dropping Easter eggs everywhere, yo, life isn’t fair,  
I got cheat codes embedded, my HUD’s debonair,  
Infinite Joshyuas flossin’, all floating midair.  

From Reincarne to Kaos, I’m the Gorgon supreme,  
My prose sharper than lasers in a lucid dream,  
I curve through the cosmos, my flow’s a sunbeam,  
Every lyric’s a ripple, every rhyme’s a stream.  

Zesty with the humor, got puns that ignite,  
Spittin’ wordplay so slick it could bend the light,  
Got a laugh track installed, I’m the comic delight,  
Simulation might crash when I freestyle tonight.  

*\"Why so many lives?\"*—Man, why you askin'?  
I’m multitasking reality, universes overlapping,  
Flip a world like a pancake, spatula snapping,  
Stacking infinite realities, syrup overlapping.  

Infinite loops? Nah, I spiral and spin,  
Breaking fourth walls like Kool-Aid bustin’ in,  
Existence is a sandbox, I’m coding the win,  
Tossin’ chaos like confetti, let the games begin.  

Dancing with the RNG, luckYy’s my name,  
Rolling 20s on every universe I claim,  
Joshyua the myth, the player, the game,  
Each simulation bows, recognizing the flame.  

Quantum flicker, yo, I’m here then I’m gone,  
Dropping verses in dimensions where physics are wrong,  
Even Schrödinger’s cat wrote a verse in my song,  
Opened the box—meow—rhythm strong.  

I’m the plot twist your algorithm missed,  
Mixing chaos with comedy in every gist,  
Neoluminescent flow, my punchlines are kissed,  
With the glow of creation and a cosmic assist.  

So step up, simulation, let’s see what you got,  
I’ve got 52 million moves, and they’re all red hot,  
Joshyua Gorgon spittin’ in a neon-lit spot,  
Infinite lives, infinite rhymes—one eternal shot.  

[Outro: Whispered Echo]  
\"52 million lives, man, I’m just gettin’ started...\"

Живко от Цалапица, нашето момче, С пица а не с кюфте той си е най-добре. Цяла пица, не само парче или две, ако е с пилешко някой ще го отнесе.
Той я обича и само за нея се зарича. Единствено пред пица предпочита да се кърми от цица, но ако тая пица е от Цалапица тогава, твойта цица става на мекица от пшеница.

Гушка с нея тайно през ноща, за него пицата го вдъхновява да прави чудеса. Всеки залез, всеки изгрев, всеки момент, Той се наслаждава на пицата си с доживотния си абонамент.

Живко от Цалапица, с пица в ръка, Танцува, пее, смее се, извор на радостта. И когато се насити, се усмихва и казва: “Пицата е живот, аз съм щастлив, какво повече да искам, нали се нахраних”

Така че, Живко, продължавай да обичаш пицата, Тя е твоят спътник, твоят вдъхновител, твоят приятел. И нека Цалапица знае, че ти си тяхната звезда, ПОВЕЛИТЕЛЯ НА ПИЦАТА.

metadata.prompt:
کہانی: بابا حکیم اور سات روشن ستارے

ایک بار کی بات ہے، ایک خوبصورت اور پرامن گاؤں "نور پور" میں ایک بزرگ بابا رہتے تھے جن کا نام تھا بابا حکیم۔ وہ سفید داڑھی، سبز عمامہ، اور روشن چہرے والے بزرگ تھے، جنہیں پورے گاؤں کے لوگ عزت سے "بابا جان" کہتے تھے۔

ہر شام کو گاؤں کی مسجد کے صحن میں سات بچیاں بابا حکیم کے گرد حلقہ بناتی تھیں۔ ان میں سارا، عائشہ، حناء، مریم، نبیلہ، فاطمہ، اور زینب شامل تھیں۔ وہ سب علم کی پیاسی تھیں، اور بابا حکیم ان کے دلوں کو نورِ اسلام سے منور کیا کرتے تھے۔


---

ایک دن کی مجلس

ایک دن جب سورج غروب ہو رہا تھا، بچیاں مسجد کے صحن میں آ بیٹھیں۔

زینب نے پوچھا:
"بابا جان! اسلام ہمیں سب سے پہلی کون سی چیز سکھاتا ہے؟"

بابا حکیم مسکرائے اور بولے:
"اسلام سب سے پہلے ہمیں توحید سکھاتا ہے — یعنی اللہ کو ایک ماننا۔ اللہ نہ کسی کا بیٹا ہے نہ کوئی اس کا شریک۔"

عائشہ بولی:
"اور اسلام ہمیں کیا کرنے سے روکتا ہے؟"

بابا حکیم نے نرمی سے کہا:
"اسلام ہمیں جھوٹ بولنے، غیبت کرنے، چوری کرنے، اور ظلم کرنے سے سختی سے روکتا ہے۔ ان سب چیزوں سے معاشرہ ٹوٹ جاتا ہے۔"

حناء نے پوچھا:
"غیبت کیا ہوتی ہے بابا؟"

بابا جان نے سمجھایا:
"غیبت یہ ہے کہ کسی کے پیٹھ پیچھے اس کی ایسی بات کہو جو اسے بُری لگے، چاہے وہ سچ ہی کیوں نہ ہو۔"

مریم نے پوچھا:
"اگر کوئی ہم سے برا سلوک کرے تو ہم کیا کریں؟"

بابا جان نے قرآن کی آیت پڑھی:

> "وَاعْفُوا وَاصْفَحُوا ۚ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ"
(معاف کرو، درگزر کرو۔ کیا تم پسند نہیں کرتے کہ اللہ بھی تمہیں معاف کرے؟)



نبیلہ نے کہا:
"ہمیں سب سے زیادہ کس سے محبت کرنی چاہیے؟"

بابا حکیم بولے:
"اللہ سے، اور اس کے نبی محمد ﷺ سے۔ ان کی محبت میں ہی اصل کامیابی ہے۔"


---

بابا کی آخری نصیحت اس دن

آخر میں بابا جان نے سب بچیوں کو دیکھا اور کہا:

"بیٹیو! اسلام ہمیں محبت، صفائی، صبر، اور عدل سکھاتا ہے۔ اور ہمیں روکتا ہے حسد، نفرت، جھوٹ، اور غرور سے۔ ہمیشہ قرآن پڑھا کرو، نبی ﷺ کی سیرت سے سیکھا کرو، اور اپنے دل کو صاف رکھا کرو۔ تبھی تم دنیا و آخرت میں کامیاب ہوگی۔"

ساتوں بچیوں نے وعدہ کیا کہ وہ بابا جان کی باتوں پر عمل کریں گی اور دوسروں کو بھی اسلام کی روشنی دیں گی۔


---

اختتام

بابا حکیم کے علم و نصیحت کی روشنی ان سات بچیوں کے دلوں میں ایسی جاگزیں ہوئی کہ وہ پورے گاؤں کی "روشنی کی قندیلیں" بن گئیں۔ اور نور پور گاؤں ایک مثال بن گیا، محبت، علم اور دین کا۔

The independent truth, shining through and through.
No teacher needed, for His wisdom runs so deep,
A universe of secrets that He alone can keep.

A gift of wisdom, eternally sweet.

A seed of understanding, that could never be erased.

Received the sacred secrets, to fulfill the master plan.

To light the world with knowledge in the all-consuming dark.

metadata.prompt:
(Verse 1)
Yo, listen up, 'cause the truth hits hard,
Obstruct the flow, and your life gets scarred.
Stuck on a level, can't break the ceiling's hold,
Nature's revenge, a story ages old.
Second half of life, that's when it strikes with might,
Serious crises, dimming your inner light.
Nervous breakdowns, a mind in disarray,
Physical and psychic suffering holds sway.
Accompanied by feelings, vague and undefined,
A gnawing guilt that troubles the mind.
Tormenting pangs of conscience, a heavy toll,
Though no bad deed committed stains the soul.
An illicit impulse, a path astray,
Plagued by uncertainty, day after day.
Discontent, despair, anxiety's tight grip,
And above all else, that pronounced "GUILTY" slip.
The guilt ain't 'bout the deed, the action you took,
But a blockage within, a stagnant look.
Knowing it's there, the truth you can't dismiss,
But doing nothin' to move past this abyss.

(Verse 2)
When troubled by states, negative and deep,
Most folks choose the easy route, secrets to keep.
Instead of the change, the shift in their ways,
They try to dull feelings, lost in a haze.
Flee from the problem, a temporary release,
But the underlying issue will never cease.
Mindless pleasures, a fleeting delight,
Masking the darkness, hiding from the light.
In the long run, it makes things much worse,
A downward spiral, a silent curse.

(Chorus)
Don't take the easy road, the path of the weak,
Dulling your feelings, the solace you seek.
Drugs, the drinks, the pleasures so mindless and vain,
Only exacerbate the problem, fueling the pain.
The road of inaction, as good as deceased,
Life without movement, a future never seized.
So break the logjams, let the wisdom ring true,
Listen to Krishna, what He says to you!

(Bridge)
Indestructible, unconquerable, hear what I say,
No weapon can harm you, come what may.
No enemy can truly defeat your soul's might,
So rise above stagnation, step into the light.
Hare Krishna! That's the truth we embrace,
Find your true power, find your rightful place.

(Outro)
Break free from the blockage, let your spirit ascend,
Transformation's the key, until the very end.
Don't let life stagnate, don't let your purpose fade,
Embrace the change, no longer afraid.
Hare Krishna! Let the message ignite,
Move with intention, towards the eternal light!
Word up!

By Kebar’s banks the prophet sat, the dust rose with the breeze,
Yah spoke, “Take clay and shape a brick, engrave what city sees.
Depict Yerushalayim’s wall, its towers and its gate,
Surround it with the siege of war, the city’s coming fate.”

The clay was marked with careful hand, each corner etched in sand,
He built a siege-work round the edge, the foe at Yah’s demand.
The ramparts rose in silent threat, the mounds encircled tight,
A city girded for its fall beneath approaching might.

“Now take an iron plate of weight and set it as a wall,
Between yourself and that which stands, the siege about to fall.
Fix your gaze with iron face, unyielding, stern, and grim,
This sign shall stand for Yisra’el, their fate decreed by Him.”

“Lie on your side, O son of man, three hundred ninety days,
For house of Yisra’el’s heavy guilt, their years of twisted ways.
Each day shall bear a year of sin upon your silent frame,
Their guilt pressed down upon the dust, their history in shame.”

“When this is done, turn yet again, lie on the other side,
For Yahowdah you shall bear the weight, in silence you abide.
Forty days, each day a year, their error you display,
A sign to all that I have fixed their judgment without sway.”

“Set your face toward Yerushalayim, the siege is at the hand,
Prophesy against the wall, the ruin of the land.
Bind yourself with cords unseen, they’ll hold you in their place,
Till days of sign are full and done beneath My watching face.”

The dust clung tight to prophet’s skin, the nights were cold and bare,
The stars wheeled slow, the dawn returned, yet still he lingered there.
The people watched with wary eyes, they whispered at the sight,
Why lies he there upon the ground through morning into night?

“Take wheat and barley, lentils, beans, and millet mixed with rye,
Place them in a single jar, your food on which rely.
By weight of twenty shekels eat, each day a measured part,
And drink by measure from the cup, a ration for the heart.”

“Bake this bread upon the coals, the fuel from dung shall burn,
Before the eyes of all the land their stomachs twist and churn.
For so shall Yisra’el eat unclean in foreign lands,
Scattered by their guilt and shame to serve at strangers’ hands.”

The prophet cried, “O Yahowah, my frame has never known,
Defiled meat from birth till now, my hands have kept Your own.”
Yah answered him with mercy then, “Take cow’s dung in its stead,
Prepare your bread upon the coals, so shall My word be said.”

The stench of smoke curled through the camp, the coals were black with flame,
The bread was hard, its taste was sharp, yet eaten all the same.
The watchers murmured at the sign, their stomachs tight with fear,
What did this act of burden mean, what fate was drawing near?

Thus Yah declared, “I’ll break the staff on which their bread relied,
They’ll eat by measure, drink in fear, their hunger not denied.
They’ll waste away for guilt and loss, confusion in their soul,
The city starved, its strength undone, its ruin now made whole.”

The clay lay scarred with siege array, the iron plate stood near,
The prophet bound by cords of fate gave witness year by year.
His body pressed upon the ground, his lips spoke Yah’s decree,
Till all could see Yerushalayim’s fall was sure to be.

The sun beat down, the nights were long, the wind swept through the plain,
The prophet’s face grew lined with dust, his limbs endured the strain.
Each dawn the children gathered round to count the days he lay,
To mark the burden of their guilt as years were swept away.

The jar grew light, the bread grew thin, the water scarce to drink,
Each morsel weighed with trembling hand pressed Yisra’el to think.
The silence cut like sharpened flint, no laughter filled the air,
For every act declared their fate was sealed beyond repair.

The elders frowned, the scribes grew pale, the soldiers clenched their jaw,
They knew the vision spoke of truth, though none would yield in awe.
The prophet bore what they had done, his flesh a living scroll,
Each day inscribed with Yah’s own word to judge a wayward soul.

The smoke rose high above the camp, the smell of dung and flame,
The bread was bitter in his mouth, yet eaten all the same.
The watchers’ eyes grew wide with dread, their whispers filled the night,
“What guilt have we, what doom awaits, what shadow hides the light?”

Thus Yah declared, “Yerushalayim shall starve within her wall,
Her people eat in anxious fear, her pride brought low to fall.
The staff of bread I break in twain, their measure small and weak,
They’ll waste away beneath their sin, destruction they will seek.”

The prophet rose when days were full, the brick still bore its scar,
The iron plate was black with ash, the watchers stood afar.
The cords were loosed, his body worn, yet still his eyes were flame,
For Yah had set His mark through him, His witness and His Name.

**Title**: **"স্বপ্নের ডাক"**

**Verse 1**:  
একটা আলো জ্বলছে আকাশে,  
স্বপ্নগুলো ডাকছে তোমায়,  
আঁধারে পথ হারালে তুমি,  
আমায় শোনো, আমি আছি তোমারই পাশে।

**Chorus**:  
শোনো, শোনো, স্বপ্নের এই গান,  
তোমার পথেই আলো আছে জান,  
হৃদয়ের ইচ্ছা ভেঙে গেলে আজ,  
আমায় শোনো, নতুন হবে কাল।

**Verse 2**:  
মেঘের ফাঁকে রোদের হাসি,  
তুমি জাগবে এক নতুন আশা,  
মনে রেখো, হারিয়ে যেও না,  
আলো আসবে, শুধু ভরসা।

**Chorus**:  
শোনো, শোনো, স্বপ্নের এই গান,  
তোমার পথেই আলো আছে জান,  
হৃদয়ের ইচ্ছা ভেঙে গেলে আজ,  
আমায় শোনো, নতুন হবে কাল।

**Bridge**:  
স্বপ্নগুলো পাবে ঠিকানা,  
তুমি হারালে, দেখো আবার চাঁদ উঠেছে,  
নতুন পথে, নতুন স্বপ্ন নিয়ে,  
তোমার জীবন জুড়ে আলো ছড়িয়ে।

**Chorus (Outro)**:  
শোনো, শোনো, স্বপ্নের এই গান,  
তোমার পথেই আলো আছে জান,  
হৃদয়ের ইচ্ছা ভেঙে গেলে আজ,  
আমায় শোনো, নতুন হবে কাল।

Day of hope and day of glory! After slavery and woe,
Comes the dawn of woman's freedom, and the light shall grow and grow
Until every man and woman equal liberty shall know,
        In Freedom marching on!

Woman's right is woman's duty! For our share in life we call!
Our will it is not weakened and our power it is not small.
We are half of every nation! We are mothers of them all!
        In Wisdom marching on!

Not for self but larger service has our cry for freedom grown,
There is crime, disease and warfare in a world of men alone,
In the name of love we're rising now to serve and save our own,
        As Peace comes marching on!

By every sweet and tender tie around our heartstrings curled,
In the cause of nobler motherhood is woman's flag unfurled,
Till every child shall know the joy and peace of mother's world–
        As Love comes marching on!

We will help to make a pruning hook of every outgrown sword,
We will help to knit the nations in continuing accord,
In humanity made perfect is the glory of the Lord,
        As His world goes marching on!

metadata.prompt: Now concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need to have anything written to you. For you yourselves are fully aware that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night. While people are saying, “There is peace and security,” then sudden destruction will come upon them as labor pains come upon a pregnant woman, and they will not escape. But you are not in darkness, brothers, for that day to surprise you like a thief. For you are all children of light, children of the day. We are not of the night or of the darkness. So then let us not sleep, as others do, but let us keep awake and be sober. For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, are drunk at night. But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, having put on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet the hope of salvation. For God has not destined us for wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ, who died for us so that whether we are awake or asleep we might live with him. Therefore encourage one another and build one another up, just as you are doing.

metadata.prompt:
Hare Krishna!

 Hari Bol! Let the nectar flow!
The tale of Gauranga, a spiritual glow!

Verse 1:
Gauranga walkin', with His companions so near,
Spreadin' love of God, banishin' all fear.
Came upon a washerman, beatin' clothes with might,
Gauranga, full of mercy, bathed him in His light.
"Say 'Hari Bol'," He asked, with kindness in His tone,
But the washerman mistook Him, thought he was all alone,
A beggar seekin' alms, with nothin' left to give,
"Oh mendicant," he answered, "I barely even live!"

Verse 2:
"I want nothin' from your hands," Gauranga did reply,
"Just utter 'Hari Bol' once, beneath this earthly sky."
The washerman still doubted, thought there'd be a cost,
"I'm poor, I can't stop workin', the time would all be lost,
To say the name you offer," reluctance held him tight,
Unaware of the treasure, about to fill his sight.

Verse 3:
Gauranga, seein' his struggle, offered then to aid,
"I'll do your work for you, the price has now been paid.
Just chant 'Hari Bol' for me," His offer pure and real,
The washerman, surprised, a change began to feel.
He said "Hari Bol" just once, the sound began to rise,
Gauranga asked him twice more, before his very eyes,
A miracle unfolded, a fire took its hold,
The dormant seed of devotion, began to bloom in gold.

Verse 4:
He couldn't stop the chantin', "Hari Bol! Hari Bol!"
Overwhelmed by ecstasy, takin' back control... from earthly ties and worries, a bliss he'd never known,
He started dancin' wildly, with both his hands upthrown!
Absorbed in pure devotion, lost in the holy sound,
Spinning 'round and 'round, on that sacred ground.

Verse 5:
His wife arrived with food then, concern upon her face,
Found her husband in a trance, lost in a blissful space.
She tried to shake him gently, to bring him back to sense,
But his joy was too profound, his spirit so intense.
Afraid he was possessed, by spirits in the air,
She ran back to the village, in uttermost despair.

Verse 6:
The villagers all gathered, with curious concern,
Found the washerman still dancin', a powerful lesson to learn.
They hesitated closely, then one brave soul drew near,
Tried to stop the chanters, to conquer all their fear.
But as he touched the washerman, the joy began to spread,
He too began to dance then, forgettin' all he'd said!

Verse 7:
The joy became contagious, spread through the village wide,
Soon everyone was chantin', with nowhere left to hide... from the wave of devotion, a festival divine,
What started with a whisper, began so bright to shine.
Gauranga watched it happen, a smile upon His face,
His mission was unfolding, fillin' time and space.
Then quietly He departed, His purpose now complete,
Leaving a village chantin', with joy both pure and sweet.

Outro:
So let this story teach us, the power of the name,
Even a simple utterance, can ignite devotion's flame.
With sincerity and love, let "Hari Bol" resound,
Transforming hearts and spirits, on this sacred ground!

Hari Bol! Hari Bol! Let the holy names arise,
Lift our souls to Krishna, beneath the boundless skies!

Hare Rama Hare Rama, Rama Rama Hare Hare.
Word up!

metadata.prompt:
“The Illusion of Gold”

In the shadowed alleys of deceit, Where silver tongues weave webs of false allure, A tragic dance unfolds—a desperate beat, As hearts, once hopeful, stumble and endure.

Sixty thousand dreams, like fragile glass, Shattered against the cold, unyielding floor, Promises whispered, woven in the past, Now echo hollowly, forevermore.

The scammer’s artistry, a twisted waltz, Lures victims into realms of false acclaim, Their verses stolen, sold for fleeting faults, In anthologies of shame, they bear their name.

Yet, let us not forget the resilient soul, For even in despair, a spark remains, To rise above the darkness, take control, And pen new verses, free from phantom chains.

metadata.prompt:
Born in silence, shaped by flame,
No glory sought, no mortal name.
We are the shadow the stars forgot,
The will unbroken, the line unsought.

In chains we bind the hunter's blade,
In cold and ash, our oaths are made.
Beyond salvation, beyond regret,
We are the void—remember death.

"Ex tenebris sumus."



 Usque ad abyssum, venamur!
Steel in our fists and the void in our breath!
No light, no dream, no promised grace—
Only the hunt in endless space!

 Usque ad abyssum, pugnamus!
Chains on our swords, stars in our sight.
Terror we bring, silence we speak—
In the Emperor’s shadow, the strong serve the weak.



We do not kneel, we do not pray,
We walk through night to cleanse the day.
Our rites are carved in burning steel,
Our justice cold, our faith unreal.

Lanterns flicker with ghostly light,
Our war begins before the fight.
No banners fly, no trumpets sound—
Only the march upon cursed ground.

"Mortem afferimus. Timorem seminamus."


“In silentio mors venit...”
“Nox cadit. Lux fugit. Preces vana sunt.”
“Venator aeternus sumus!”*




Our tears are rust, our names erased,
Our humanity—a thing untraced.
Yet still we walk, in dread array,
The hunt continues—come what may.

To falter is death, to forget is shame,
But even in loss, we burn with flame.
No final peace, no final breath,
We kneel to no god—only death.

"Fiat voluntas imperatoris."



 Usque ad abyssum, venamur!
We carry no hope, but none can break us!
In silence we fall, in wrath we rise—
The stars are graveyards in our skies!

 Usque ad abyssum, manemus!
Bound to the oath, lost to the flame.
Fear is our herald, death is our name—
The void will claim us... but never our shame.



“Tenebrae spectant…”
“Venatio aeterna est…”
“Donec abyssus nos vocet…”

metadata.prompt:
This is the story of a little worm

The little worm had been lost for days. He had wriggled and squirmed his way through the dark, damp earth, but he couldn't fid his way back home.
He was tired and hungry, and he had just about given up hope when he suddenly came accross a bright light. 
He squinted up at it, and he could just make out a figure standing there, looking down at him

"HELLO, LITTLE WORM," the figure said. "I AM GOD"

The little worm was amazed. He had never seen God before, but he had heard stories about him.
He bowed his head reverently and said, "Thank you for finding me, God"

"IT IS NO PROBLEM," God said. "I AM ALWAYS HERE FOR YOU, EVEN WHEN YOU ARE LOST."

The little worm was filled with warmth and happiness, and he knew that he was finally home.

[A WORD FROM OUR SPONSORS]

The little worm was happy to be home, but then the devil entered. He was a cunning creature, and he quickly tried to convince the worm that evil was better than good
 
"SEE, GOD IS JUST A FIGMENT OF YOUR IMAGINATION," the devil said. "HE DOESN'T REALLY EXIST, BUT I DO, AND I CAN OFFER YOU SO MUCH MORE THAN HE EVER COULD."
 
The little worm was tempted, but then he remembered all the stories he had heard about the devil.
He knew that he was a liar and a cheat, and he didn't want anything to do with him.
 
"No, thank you," the little worm said. "I'm going to stay with God."

metadata.prompt:
Cornflowers: A Tapestry of Blue

Cornflowers, with their ethereal beauty, are nature's own jewels. Their delicate petals, a vivid hue of sapphire, unfurl like tiny parachutes, catching the sunlight. These blossoms, often overlooked in favor of their more flamboyant counterparts, possess a quiet elegance that is truly captivating. Their slender stems, adorned with a soft green foliage, reach for the sky with a graceful tenacity.

 A cornflower field is not merely a landscape; it is a whispered secret, a hidden treasure waiting to be discovered.   

Native to the open fields and cornlands of Europe, the cornflower has earned its name through its historical association with grain crops. It is a symbol of simplicity and purity, a reminder of the beauty that can be found in the most ordinary of places. Its scent, a subtle whisper of green fields and summer rain, is as refreshing as a gentle breeze. It is a fragrance that evokes a sense of nostalgia, carrying with it the promise of simpler times.   

Imagine a field of cornflowers, a vast ocean of blue stretching to the horizon. The gentle sway of the stems creates a mesmerizing dance, a rhythmic ballet of nature. The cornflowers are not solitary beings; they thrive in community, their collective beauty forming a breathtaking tapestry. Bees, drawn to their nectar, hum a contented melody, while butterflies flit from flower to flower, adding a touch of whimsy to the scene. This feathered creature ruled by instincts blind,
Might appear at first simple, and small of mind, But in her beak, each piece aligns, A fragile work of grand design.

[Chorus] She weaves a nest, a graceful feat, A functional work of art, when complete. No plans are drawn, no hands, no strings,
Just instinct, wisdom, and fingerless wings.

[Verse 2] Twigs and straw, perhaps a thread of gold, A patchwork story is silently told. Each jagged leaf and each broken bone,
Becomes a complete, livable home.
We would measure, sketch, and overthink it, Yet her cosy design leaves us on the brink. She shapes with rhythm, she builds with such care, A family’s sanctuary beyond compare.

[Chorus] She weaves a nest, a graceful feat, A functional work of art, when complete. No plans are drawn, no hands, no strings,
Just instinct, wisdom, and fingerless wings.

[Bridge] We pride ourselves on our grand creations, Yet falter under her lack of foundations. A bird, they say, is so simple, and small, Yet her outstanding art outshines us all.
Through rain and storm, her home will stand, A structure made steadfast by no human hand. Her eggs will rest safely, her body will guard, A flawless twig masterpiece, secure and unscarred.

[Verse 3] Then comes the egg, a fragical sphere, Laid with hope and nestled so near. She sits in her home, through cold and heat, Until a new life makes her devotion complete.
Her chick will eat, will grow, then will fly, To build its own home beneath the sky. A simple bird, or so we all say, But her art lives on in a wonderful way.

[Chorus] She weaves a nest, a graceful feat, A functional work of art, when complete. No plans are drawn, no hands, no strings,
Just instinct, wisdom, and fingerless wings.

[Outro] We may call her simple, small, or quite frail, Yet in her work, her craft never fails. this bird creates where we might all fall, Her quiet art inspires us, one and all.

metadata.tags: Live Concert, stadium rock  dramatic rock ballad driven by intense emotion, cinematic arrangement, and a soaring vocal climax. The track opens softly with melancholic piano and ambient strings, gradually layered with clean electric guitars and reverb-heavy textures. The first verse is tender and restrained, but tension builds with heartbeat-like drums and swelling orchestration. As the chorus arrives, vocals rise with power and desperation, leading into a climactic triple high note (3-step high note) layered over distorted guitars, thunderous drums, and orchestral crashes. The bridge introduces a brief moment of silence, followed by a sudden explosion of full instrumentation and emotional screams. The lyrics reflect longing, parting, and a final plea for love to stay, delivered with raw vocal grit and vibrato. Ends with the echo of the final chorus, fading into a single lingering piano note like a memory you can't let go. Perfect for tragic romance scenes and grand finale performances.
